# AI Site Scan: full text

> The text of every public page of AI Site Scan (getaisitescan.com), in Markdown. Short index: https://getaisitescan.com/llms.txt

## AI Site Scan: can AI read your website?

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/

Free check, no login. See what AI sees, and what to fix first.

### What AI Site Scan checks

AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews answer questions with text they fetch from websites. Most of them read the raw HTML and do not run JavaScript. If they cannot reach, read or understand your page, they skip it or describe it wrong. This tool tests your page the way they do, in 1 to 3 seconds, and tells you what to fix first.

- **Get in.** 14 AI crawlers and assistants, from GPTBot and ClaudeBot to PerplexityBot, request your page. You see which ones get it and which ones your server or robots.txt turns away.
- **Read.** Your page without JavaScript, side by side with a real browser screenshot. If your text only appears after scripts run, AI sees an almost empty page.
- **Understand.** Titles, headings, structured data (JSON-LD), brand signals and, for local businesses, whether the page says where you are.
- **Trust and find more.** Contact details, dates, the sitemap, llms.txt and 23 agent-readiness standards, rated as a level from 0 to 5.

### Pricing

#### Free check

A score from 0 to 100, the AI view, the bot test, every issue with what the AI saw, and the top 3 fixes in full. No login.

#### Full report

Every fix with steps and ready-to-paste code, filled in for your site, plus 1 rescan within 30 days. Emailed to you and saved in your account.

#### Pro

10 full reports a month for any sites, with rescans. For freelancers and agencies. Cancel anytime.

- **Log in with your email or Google** when you buy. No password.
- **Instant delivery.** After you pay, every fix opens here. We email you the report and save it in your account.
- **Secure checkout by Polar**, our merchant of record. We never see your card details.
- **7-day refund** on the Full report. Pro renews monthly until you cancel. [Pricing details](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing) · [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund)
- **Self-serve.** The report tells you or your developer what to change. We do not log in to your site.

### Questions

**Does a high score mean ChatGPT will cite my site?** No. The score shows how easy it is for AI tools to reach and understand your page. Whether they cite you also depends on your content and your reputation.

**Where does the score come from?** We check 9 areas, such as robots.txt, structured data, content and brand signals, for a total of 100 points. Our extra checks, such as the bot test and agent readiness, do not change the score.

**Do you store my results?** Your history stays in your own browser. Our server keeps a result for 10 minutes, so a repeat check is fast.

**What is in the full fix guide?** Every fix for your site, ranked, with the steps and ready-to-paste code filled in for your pages: JSON-LD, llms.txt, robots.txt and head tags. It is one Markdown file you can hand to a developer or an AI coding tool.

**How do I get the report after I pay?** Right away. You log in with your email or Google, pay on Polar's secure checkout and come back here. Every fix opens on screen, and we email you the report and save it in your account.

**Is it a subscription?** The Full report ($19) is a one-time payment. Pro ($29 a month, 10 reports) is a subscription that renews monthly until you cancel it in your account.

**Can I get a refund?** Yes. Email us within 7 days of buying a Full report for a full refund, no reason needed. For Pro, see the refund policy.

Made by [Daniel Rojansky](https://getaisitescan.com/about) in Israel. Updated Nov 28, 2026. Also see the [llms.txt checker](https://getaisitescan.com/llms-txt) and the [AI robots.txt checker](https://getaisitescan.com/ai-robots-txt).

Why sites pick AI Site Scan:

- It tests, not guesses: requests as 14 AI bots show what your server and firewall really answer.

## How we test

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/how-we-test

Three kinds of AI visit a website. Search crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 10 more) get the raw HTML; many do not run JavaScript, and this gives the 0 to 100 score. Agents that read the page (Claude in Chrome, Perplexity Comet, ChatGPT agent) use the accessibility tree: we open the page in headless Chrome at 1280 x 800 and read every heading, button, link and field with its name. Agents that look at the screen (ChatGPT agent, Gemini in Chrome) use screenshots: we mark every layer that covers the page at load.

Agent checks (pass 1, warning half, grade A to F, not part of the score):

- Find: Search has a results page at its own address. A search box in a GET form, so results open at an address like /search?q=shoes. A search that only opens a pop-up fails.
- Find: Every page has its own address. No #/ addresses that load the same page.
- Read: Every button and link has a name. The accessible name: visible text, aria-label, a label, or the alt text of an image inside. 1 to 2 missing is a warning, 3 or more fail.
- Read: Names are clear and unique. 3 or more buttons with the same name, or 3 or more links that only say Read more, give a warning.
- Read: One main heading names the page. Exactly one h1.
- Act: Clickable things are real buttons and links. Boxes with a pointer cursor that are not buttons, links or form parts. 3 or more warn, 10 or more fail.
- Forms: Form fields have labels. A label, aria-label or aria-labelledby. Placeholder text alone does not count.
- Forms: Fields say what they want. Email, phone and name fields need the right type and an autocomplete value.
- Pop-ups: Nothing covers the page when it loads. Fixed layers over the screen at 1280 x 800. A layer over the middle, or over 30% of the screen, fails. A smaller one, or one with an unnamed close button, warns. A sticky menu bar and a small chat button are fine.
- Understand: Content does not change by itself. We read sliders twice, 2.5 seconds apart. A slider that changed by itself warns.
- Shop: Prices are text with a currency. Only when the page sells something (Product data or an Add to cart button).
- Shop: Product data has price, currency and stock. Product JSON-LD with an Offer.
- Shop: Stock is stated in words. In stock, Only 2 left, Sold out.
- Shop: Add to cart is a named button. A button or link named Add to cart, Buy now or similar.

Not tested: we read one page once without logging in and never fill forms, order or pay, so guest checkout, totals before payment, payment fields and confirmation pages are listed in the report as manual checks.

Sources:

- OpenAI: Publishers and Developers FAQ (ARIA and ChatGPT agent, OAI-SearchBot): https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12627856-publisher-faq
- OpenAI: Computer-Using Agent (the model behind ChatGPT agent works from screenshots): https://openai.com/index/computer-using-agent/
- OpenAI: Atlas is moving into ChatGPT (Atlas stopped on August 9, 2026): https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001371
- Anthropic: Claude in Chrome: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12012173-claude-in-chrome
- Google: Gemini in Chrome auto browse: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/16821166
- Google DeepMind: Project Mariner: https://deepmind.google/technologies/project-mariner/
- Search Engine Journal: How AI agents see your website (April 2026): https://www.searchenginejournal.com/how-ai-agents-see-your-website-and-how-to-build-for-them/570443/
- Cloudflare: isitagentready.com (the agent readiness standards): https://isitagentready.com/
- Instinct: "Making Your Website Work for AI Agents" (checklist shared with us, November 2026)

## About AI Site Scan

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/about

AI Site Scan shows how AI tools see a website. You enter an address, and in 1 to 3 seconds you get an AI readiness score from 0 to 100, the page as an AI tool reads it, a test of 14 AI bots, and a ranked list of fixes.

### Who makes it

AI Site Scan is made and run by Daniel Rojansky, an independent product and technology consultant in Israel (trade name: Daniel Consulting). It is a small, independent product. See the [contact page](https://getaisitescan.com/contact) for business details.

### How the score works

- The score covers 9 areas, such as robots.txt, structured data, content and brand signals, for a total of 100 points.
- AI Site Scan adds its own checks: a test of 14 AI crawlers and assistants, 23 agent-readiness standards, page speed and size, headings, links and a location check for local businesses. These extra checks do not change the score.
- The checks are rules in code. The fix guide is built from your results by the same rules. No AI model writes it.
- A higher score means AI tools find the page easier to read. It does not promise citations or rankings.

### How we make money

The check is free. We sell the full report in two ways: $19 once for 1 site, or Pro at $29 a month for 10 reports a month. There are no ads on the site, and we do not sell data. See [Pricing](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing).

### What the scan keeps

Your scan history stays in your own browser. Our server keeps a result for 10 minutes so a repeat check is fast, and short-term logs. See the [privacy policy](https://getaisitescan.com/privacy) for details.

### Contact

Email support@getaisitescan.com.

### Delivery

1. Polar sends you back to AI Site Scan, and every fix opens on screen within seconds.

If the report does not open or does not arrive within 15 minutes, check your spam folder, then email support@getaisitescan.com. We will fix it.

### Cancel Pro

Log in, open "My reports", and click "Receipts and subscription". There you can cancel in a few clicks. You can also email us and we will cancel it for you. After you cancel, nothing more is charged, and Pro stays active until the end of the month you paid for.

### Refunds

- **Pro:** if you did not use any report in a month, email us within 7 days of that month's charge and we refund it. If you forgot to cancel, tell us: we will be fair.
- Write from the email you log in with, or include it and the order number.

- After a refund, the reports from that payment are no longer available.
- After 7 days, we still refund you if we could not deliver the report, or if it does not work because of a fault on our side.

### Before you dispute a charge

Please email us first. We answer fast, and a refund from us is quicker than a dispute with your bank.

### Price changes

We may change prices for future orders. For Pro, we email you at least 30 days before a new price applies, and you can cancel before then.

## Terms of service

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/terms

### 1. Who we are

AI Site Scan (getaisitescan.com) is run by Daniel Rojansky, a sole trader registered in Israel, trading as Daniel Consulting ("we", "us"). Contact: support@getaisitescan.com. These terms apply when you use the site, create an account, or buy a report.

### 2. The service

The check is free. It tests public web pages and shows how AI tools can reach, read and understand them. The full report is a paid digital product. It lists every fix for a site, with steps and ready-to-paste code.

To test access for AI tools, the scanner requests the page you enter with the user agent names that those tools publish. It also reads public files such as robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt. It reads only public pages. It does not log in, and it does not get past paywalls or other access controls.

### 3. Your account

To buy, you create an account with your email address (we send you a one-time code) or with Google. Keep access to that email safe. Your reports are saved in your account. You can ask us to delete the account and its reports at any time.

### 4. Fair use

Check your own sites, or sites you have permission to test. Do not use the scanner to overload, attack or probe a site, or to check many sites in bulk with scripts. We limit how often one visitor can scan, and we may block traffic that looks like abuse.

### 5. Plans, prices and payment

Prices are on the [pricing page](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing), in US dollars. The Full report is a one-time payment for 1 site, with 1 rescan within 30 days. Pro is a monthly subscription with 10 reports a month. Unused Pro reports do not carry over.

Polar Software, Inc. ("Polar") is our merchant of record and authorized reseller. When you buy, you buy from Polar, and Polar's [Buyer Terms](https://polar.sh/legal/checkout-buyer-terms) also apply. Polar takes the payment, adds sales tax or VAT where it applies, and sends your receipt. Your right to use the reports comes from these terms. We never see or store your card details.

### 6. Subscription renewal and cancellation

Pro renews automatically every month and Polar charges your payment method until you cancel. You can cancel anytime from your account ("Receipts and subscription") or by email. Pro then stays active until the end of the paid month. We email you at least 30 days before a price change.

Delivery is digital and instant. After payment, the report opens on the site, is emailed to you and is saved in your account. Details are on the [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund) page.

### 8. Using the reports

You may use the reports and their code on the sites you checked, for yourself or for your clients. Do not resell the reports as a product or share your account.

### 9. Refunds

The refund rules are on the [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund) page.

### 10. No guarantee

The score and the fixes come from an automated tool. They do not promise that AI tools or search engines will read, cite or rank a site, or that traffic will grow. Check each fix, and back up your site, before you change it.

### 11. Availability

We work to keep the site running, but we cannot promise that it is always available or free of errors. We may change, add or remove features. If we stop the service, you can download your saved reports first, and we refund the unused part of a Pro month.

## Privacy policy

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/privacy

### Who is responsible

Daniel Rojansky, trading as Daniel Consulting, Israel, is responsible for your data. Contact: support@getaisitescan.com.

### What we collect and why

- **Addresses you check.** We fetch the page you enter, and some public files of that site, to make your report. The result stays in a server cache for 10 minutes. Server logs keep the site, the score and the time for a short time.
- **Scan history.** It stays only in your browser. You can delete it in the History tab.
- **Your account.** Your email address. If you log in with Google, also your name and profile picture from Google. We use them to log you in and to send your reports.
- **Your reports and purchases.** The reports you unlock (site, score, fixes), what you bought and how many reports you have left. They are saved in your account so you can open them again.
- **Emails.** We email you your reports and, if you ask for it on the free check, one reminder. Emails go out through Resend. We do not add you to a newsletter.
- **Messages you send us.** We keep them to answer you and to keep a record of support requests.
- **Analytics.** PostHog records page views, clicks and scan steps, so we can improve the product. Until you accept cookies, it stores nothing in your browser. If you accept, it keeps an ID in a cookie and in local storage. Session recordings hide what you type.
- **Advertising.** Only if you accept cookies, Google Ads measures whether a visit from an ad led to a purchase.
- **Payments.** Polar processes payments as our merchant of record. We receive your name, email, country and what you bought. We never see your card details.

### Legal bases

We use your data to give you what you asked for, such as an account, a report or a purchase (contract). We use analytics and advertising cookies, and send a reminder email, only with your consent. We keep short server logs to protect the service from abuse (legitimate interest).

### Who processes it

These service providers process data for us, each under its own data protection terms: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (login and database), PostHog (analytics), Resend (email), Polar (payments, as merchant of record), Google (login, only if you choose it, and ads, only with your consent). They may process data in the United States, the European Union and other countries. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it for other companies' marketing.

### How long we keep it

- Scan results: 10 minutes in the server cache.
- Server logs: a few days at most.
- Your account and saved reports: until you ask us to delete them.
- Support messages: up to 2 years.
- Purchase records: as long as tax and accounting law requires. Polar keeps the payment records as merchant of record.

### Cookies and browser storage

**Always on, because the site needs them:** your login session, your scan history and your cookie choice. They stay in your browser's local storage.

**Only after you accept:** PostHog analytics (a cookie and a local storage ID) and Google Ads conversion cookies. To change your choice, clear this site's data in your browser and choose again.

### Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it (including your whole account), or object to how we use it. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Email support@getaisitescan.com, and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to your data protection authority. In Israel, that is the Privacy Protection Authority.

### Children

AI Site Scan is for website owners and businesses. It is not meant for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

### Security

The whole site uses HTTPS. Logins use one-time codes or Google, so we store no passwords. Card details go only to Polar's checkout. We keep as little data as we can.

### Changes

We post every change on this page and update the date at the top.
